purpose: Responsible for the preparation of all distribution network development plans that will sustain the cooperative's electric distribution system and ensures the efficient and timely implementation of Network CAPEX and OPEX projects. Responsible for the development of strategies and business plans for efficient safe, reliable, economic and regulatory compliant utilization of the distribution networks. Work involves the application of a comprehensive technical knowledge of distribution, metering and telecommunications operations in resolving work problems. Duties involve the exercise of considerable independent judgement after reviewing official reports from staff, observations and results obtained and learnings from conferences/trainings.

sourceTitle: Construction and Maintenance Officer I, II, III
title: Construction and Maintenance Officer
purpose: Responsible for seeing to the effective maintenance and operation of the electric distribution lines, line equipment and accessories ensuring efficient, reliable and safe service. Responsible for supervising and monitoring all construction projects being implemented by the line contractors and linemen and ensuring the strict implementation of safety and line construction standards all the time. Responsible for the proper coordination, operation and maintenance of the transmission, substation and distribution system protection to ensure a safe and reliable service at all times.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description:
Level I

Develop a Comprehensive IEC program to support BENECO’s goal to strengthen awareness of MCOs.

Lead in implementing approved IEC programs.

Lead in the implementation of the Annual General Membership Assembly (AGMA).

Lead in the implementation of the District Elections.

Design and Develop survey form/feedback mechanism to determine effectivity of IEC programs.

Analyze data gathered from survey forms/feedback mechanism to determine effectivity of program and prepare report for information of management.

Lead the continuation of community organizing activities to establish Member Consumer Organizations (MCOs) in every barangay.

Develop and implement a comprehensive workplan to systematically merge the present COMREL activities with that of community building involvements for renewable energy projects.

Prepare the compliance reports and submissions of the Community Relations Office and documents required by government regulatory agencies relative to renewable energy projects.

Develop and implement a comprehensive workplan to systematically merge the present COMREL activities with that of community building involvements for renewable energy projects.

Monitor and strategize the field works of the Community Relations Associates as to PMES, IECs, coordination and networking including the timely submission of post activity reports, liquidation and quarterly accomplishments.

Write news releases, profiles and stories highlighting community relations activities.

Engage the community stakeholder in terms of information and education on the Indigenous People’s Rights

Level II (including all tasks/responsibilities of Level I)

Attend meetings of IPs/ICCs, Government, Non-Government and other organizations.

Develop and evaluate PR/Communication Plan

Establish a strong network with local and provincial government units

Establish networks with Indigenous People and Indigenous Cultural Communities with the end in view of forging joint venture, partnership or arrangement under terms and conditions that are mutually acceptable to them and the electric cooperative in the latter pursuit of renewable energy development
Conducts strategic planning for community relations programs

Propose, evaluate and assist in any image building and CSR programs

Level III (including all tasks/responsibilities of Level I and II)

To assist the point person for communities and local government units where development projects initiated by the Power Generations Department are ongoing particularly those that need pre-development community orientation and post development community monitoring and assessment

To assist the point person for the National Government Agencies like the National Commission on Indigenous People (NCIP), Department of Energy (DOE), National Water Resources Board (NWRB), and the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)

To assist the point person in the coordination with the National Commission on Indigenous People (NCIP) in the conduct of the Field Base Investigation (FBI) and the conduct of Free and Prior Informed Consent (FPIC) of the Indigenous People/ Indigenous Cultural Communities (IPs/ICCs)

To assist the point person in the coordination with the National Commission on Indigenous People (NCIP) in the conduct of validation of the Memorandum of Agreement on projects initiated by the Indigenous People/ Indigenous Cultural Communities (IPs/ICCs) in the exercise of priority rights

Assist the partner Ancestral Domain Indigenous People Organization (AD-IPO) on programs and project to strengthen their organizations
Works closely with the ISD MANAGER in periodically evaluating the efficiency of the operations of the ComRel Office.

Performs specific community relations tasks when need arises.

sourceTitle: Power Supply and Energy Trading Associate I, II, III, IV
title: Power Supply and Energy Trading Associate
purpose:
Responsible for ensuring a sufficient regular power supply and renewable energy supply in compliance with the Renewable Portfolio Standards (RPS), at the most efficient and economical way while complying with the WESM Rules and all related regulatory requirements.
Responsible for ensuring that the generation mix (bilateral contracts, WESM and REM for RPS requirements) are optimized.
Responsible for transmitting metered quantities of consumers under RCOA, GEOP, Net Metering and RE Law to the Independent Electricity Market Operator of the Philippines and the Philippine Electricity Market Corporation and other relevant agencies.

title: INTERNAL AUDITOR
purpose: Responsible for the conduct of an independent appraisal of various operating and IT systems within BENECO to ensure conformity of transactions and implementation of policies, guidelines and internal control.

duties.subject: General

duties.subject: General
duties.description: Purpose of the Position: Responsible for the conduct of an independent appraisal of various operating and IT systems within BENECO to ensure conformity of transactions and implementation of policies, guidelines and internal control.

duties.subject: General
duties.description: Key Result Areas/Duties and Responsibilities

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 1. Leads the preparation, implementation and monitoring of audit plans and programs of the Internal Audit Office

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 2. Leads in the preparation of the Cash Operating Budget of BENECO and Budget for the Internal Audit Office.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 3. Checks the validity and accuracy of disbursements and other financial transactions and ensures compliance to established policies and generally accepted accounting and audit standards.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 4. Analyzes and reviews the accuracy and reliability of financial reports and operating information generated by the cooperative.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 5. Assesses and evaluates operating and IT systems and procedures, determines its effectiveness and adequacy of internal control and makes corresponding recommendations for improvement/enhancement, if appropriate.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 6. Reviews the means of safeguarding assets from loss of all kinds and verify the existence of such assets.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 7. Prepares, reviews or evaluates audit reports/findings and makes corresponding recommendation/s to Management or actions to be undertaken by the appropriate department/office/personnel.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 8. Ascertains if corrective measures have been undertaken on findings by NEA and External Auditors and whether audit recommendations are carried out by Management.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 9. Oversees the extent of compliance with established coop policies, plans, procedures and regulatory agencies' policies, rules, guidelines and reportorial requirements.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 10. Assesses audit evidence to establish appropriateness and validity of related financial statement assertion.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 11. Identifies areas where special audit considerations maybe necessary.

duties.subject: Operational Efficiency
duties.description: 12. Acts and responds to memos, communications from internal and external clients.

duties.subject: Administrative Efficiency
duties.description: Supervises and directs the Internal Audit Team in the performance of their audit functions and activities.

duties.description: Conform with Quality Policy and related Quality objectives

duties.subject: QMS related responsibilities
duties.description: Conform with related Quality procedures and supporting documents.

duties.subject: General
duties.description:
ADMINSTRATIVE EFFICIENCY
Receives and/or places telephone calls and messages for the Manager and keeps record of the same
Attends to phone in/walk in complaints, queries and requests
Takes dictation, transcribes and type letters, reports and other correspondence as directed by the Department Manager
Coordinates, monitors and reminds appointments of the Department Manager
Regularly submits reports of activities and accomplishment of the Department Manager
Sees to good housekeeping in the office and attends to the Department Manager’s visitors
Observes the highest standard of work ethics and manifests corporate values in all activities
Keeps an efficient inventory level of office supplies needed by the Department and keeps record of the same
Process reimbursement of petty cash and prepares summary for replenishment

sourceTitle: Meter Reading, Billing and Disconnection Officer I, II, III
title: Meter Reading, Billing and Disconnection Officer
purpose:
Responsible for monitoring and implementation of accurate, effective and efficient meter reading and billing activities, ensuring the preparation of accurate reports, makes corresponding recommendations and leads the meter readers in the practice of highest ethical and work standards.
Responsible in the implementation of the disconnection of delinquent member-consumers and reconnection of the same upon payment of all requirements in order to attain high collection efficiency. Responsible for designing and implementing an excellent consumer assistance program, ensuring timely response to their concerns and keeping accurate and complete consumer record that is available to all Departments when needed in the operation.
